_about: Which lift on the map is which lift in the resort's live feed (cervinia.it/en/impianti). Keys are the feed's names, values the OpenStreetMap way ids of that lift. 'covered' is the box of the lifts the feed reports on (Breuil-Cervinia and Valtournenche): a lift there that is missing from today's feed is not running today. Lifts outside the box and not named here - most of Zermatt - have no live state, and the router says so.
_about_zermatt: Names on the Zermatt Bergbahnen page (matterhornparadise.ch, lifts and pistes), saved by the scraper as lifts_detail.zermatt. A Zermatt lift named here but missing from that page reads as unknown, not closed: the names there are not yet checked against a full winter's list. '@GGB' is the Gornergrat railway, reported there section by section.
_about_railway: The stations of the Gornergrat railway (GGB) where a skier gets on or off, by OpenStreetMap node. The first four come with the raw download; Riffelalp and Gornergrat are mapped there only as stop positions on the track (nodes 313517237 and 313518319), copied here from OSM until the download fetches stop positions itself.
